title: Brownian Motion
shortDescription: An interactive simulation of Brownian motion showing how random particle collisions lead to diffusion and emergent patterns.
fullDescription: Adjust temperature, particle types, and density to explore how simple rules create complex behavior. This simulation demonstrates the random motion of particles as they collide and interact, revealing how microscopic chaos leads to macroscopic diffusion patterns. Watch as different particle types mix and separate based on their properties.
features: Real-time parameter adjustment | Multiple particle types | Density visualization | Periodic boundaries

title: Gravitational N-Body Simulation
shortDescription: An interactive simulation of gravitational dynamics with thermal energy tracking.
fullDescription: Explore how gravitational forces shape the motion of multiple bodies in space. This simulation demonstrates N-body physics where each object interacts with all others through gravity, revealing emergent patterns in orbital dynamics. Watch as particles form clusters, orbits, and complex gravitational interactions.
